correctness.rationale: Every vertex sees precisely the other odd-sized part. Until the first local-majority flip, only initially dissenting agents relative to their current neighbor majority can flip, once, at independent first-update times. The sign is decided by whether the s-th of k clocks precedes the r-th of i clocks, equivalently a uniform order-statistics hypergeometric event on first r+s-1 clocks. Both thresholds cannot be reached simultaneously. Exponential spacing sums give means H_i-H_u, H_k-H_v, variance reciprocal-square sums and a Lyapunov triangular-array CLT. On y=1-x, the normalized mean/variance yield Phi(c sqrt(lambda(1-lambda))/sqrt(x(2x-1))). No assertion for even parts, vanishing lambda or x=1/2; independent exact first-step Markov recurrence agreed with formula for 1764 configurations.
